sections_layout.name: Navigation
sections_layout.description: Sticky top bar. Left: 'CodeOrbit' logo in Unbounded font. Right: CTA 'Join Waitlist'. Must include data-testids.

sections_layout.name: Hero Section
sections_layout.description: Massive terminal/orbit visual. Background image of space orbit with heavy black overlay (opacity 70%). Headline: 'Command Your Career.' Subheadline: 'DSA mentoring for the top 1%.' Font: Unbounded. Includes two CTAs.

sections_layout.name: Social Proof / Logo Ticker
sections_layout.description: Section starting with mono label 'MENTORS FROM'. Followed by a horizontal flex/marquee of Amazon, Uber, and Adobe logos. CRITICAL: Logos must have Tailwind classes 'brightness-0 invert opacity-50' to appear white/grey.

sections_layout.name: Curriculum Bento
sections_layout.description: Tetris bento grid detailing DSA topics (Arrays, Trees, Graphs, DP, System Design). Include a block with an image of code on a dark screen.

sections_layout.name: Testimonials
sections_layout.description: Grid of 3 minimal cards. Avatar images of students, glowing 5-star icons, and quote text. Use monospaced font for student names/roles.

sections_layout.name: Stats Command Center
sections_layout.description: 3 large metric counters. Number in huge Acid Green font (text-6xl+). Labels in uppercase mono.

sections_layout.name: Footer
sections_layout.description: Massive dark footer. Generous spacing (py-32). Big 'READY TO ORBIT?' heading and final CTA.

hero_bg.description: Glowing planets in empty space. Use for hero overlay background.

developer_coding.description: Developer coding in dark. Use inside Bento Grid as a visual.

instructions_to_main_agent: MUST load Google Fonts: Unbounded (400,700,900), IBM Plex Sans (400,500), and JetBrains Mono (400).
MUST apply 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements, buttons, and links.
Do NOT use typical purple/blue/teal gradients. Stick strictly to black, white, and zinc-900s, using Acid Green (#4ade80) ONLY for specific stark highlights.
Bento Grid implementation MUST use pure HTML/Tailwind classes, avoiding rigid components that break asymmetry.
Logos must be rendered white on the dark background using Tailwind 'brightness-0 invert' classes.
Ensure image overlays never hide text. Hero text must have contrast.
Code Orbit logo should just be styled text in the Unbounded font.
